page.overview:
What is Pyrulea?

Pyrulea is an odd plane that Dyfed escorted Yawgmoth to in order to prove her abilities as a planeswalker to him.

Pyrulea is composed of a densely forested sphere around a central star; the plane's inhabitants live on the interior surface of the sphere. What's more, the size of the plant life is particularly enlarged.

The plane may be artificial, as planes are not normally inverted spheres. The description matches the astronomical concept of a Dyson sphere.

Bright birds dart among the broad leaves, and strange orchids, with pink petals as vast as a hand and edged in brown, grow here. According to Dyfed, there are also intelligent creatures that live in this world.
